project.name: osgi/domains/incus/incus-contract
project.description: The incus domain's contract — both contacts toward an Incus host (an instance needs an image, one concern). IncusInstanceContact (is a launched instance reachable, checked by running a trivial command on it) + its flat IncusExecRequest; and ImageBuilder (build the seed image's Incus artifacts, plus recipeDigest so the host folds the edge-owned recipe into its cache key) + its flat ImageBuildRequest and ImageBuildException. The incus-edge satisfies both by shelling `ssh … incus exec` / `nix build`. type=contract: installed bundle-side and wired bundle-to-bundle, not system-exported — the host speaks only to the broker.
